const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"python3 -B -c '
import json, re, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd() / "tools"))
from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from i18nlib.lint import MARKUP_RE, AT_TOKEN_RE
ROOT = Path.cwd()
TASK = ROOT / ".ai/task/repair-w58-20261001"
BASE = "12376f4bfd991734907d9d2afa08bc7fba0abb0f"
FILES = ("mod-tome.lua", "tome-cults.lua", "tome-orcs.lua")
loader = LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest()))
workset = json.loads((TASK / "WORKSET.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["items"]
frozen = json.loads((TASK / "BASELINE-records.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
key = lambda filename, row: (filename, row.get("section"), row.get("source"), row.get("source_tag"))
expected = {key(item["normalized_path"], item): item for item in workset}
assert len(expected) == 3
placeholder_re = re.compile(r"%[-+ #0]*\\d*(?:\\.\\d+)?[cdeEfgGiouXxqs%]")
template_re = re.compile(r"<\\?.*?\\?>")
changed = []
record_counts = {}
translation_counts = {}
for filename in FILES:
    old_loaded = loader.load_bytes(subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", f"{BASE}:{filename}"]), logical_path=filename)
    new_loaded = loader.load_path(ROOT / filename, logical_path=filename)
    old_records, new_records = old_loaded.records, new_loaded.records
    assert len(old_records) == len(new_records), filename
    record_counts[filename] = len(new_records)
    translation_counts[filename] = len(new_loaded.translations)
    frozen_matches = [row for row in old_records if key(filename, row) in expected]
    assert frozen_matches == frozen[filename], f"frozen baseline mismatch: {filename}"
    for before, after in zip(old_records, new_records):
        if before == after:
            continue
        row_key = key(filename, before)
        assert row_key in expected, f"out-of-scope record: {row_key}"
        item = expected[row_key]
        assert before["target"] == item["target_preimage"]
        assert {k: v for k, v in before.items() if k != "target"} == {k: v for k, v in after.items() if k != "target"}, item["entry_revision_identity"]
        old_target, new_target = before["target"], after["target"]
        assert old_target.count("\\n") == new_target.count("\\n")
        assert [line == "" for line in old_target.split("\\n")] == [line == "" for line in new_target.split("\\n")]
        assert [len(line) - len(line.lstrip("\\t")) for line in old_target.split("\\n")] == [len(line) - len(line.lstrip("\\t")) for line in new_target.split("\\n")]
        assert old_target.endswith("\\n") == new_target.endswith("\\n")
        assert placeholder_re.findall(old_target) == placeholder_re.findall(new_target)
        assert MARKUP_RE.findall(old_target) == MARKUP_RE.findall(new_target)
        assert AT_TOKEN_RE.findall(old_target) == AT_TOKEN_RE.findall(new_target)
        assert template_re.findall(old_target) == template_re.findall(new_target)
        changed.append({"revision": item["entry_revision_identity"], "file": filename, "line": after["line"]})
assert {row["revision"] for row in changed} == {item["entry_revision_identity"] for item in workset}
assert len(changed) == 3
current = {item["entry_revision_identity"]: next(row for row in loader.load_path(ROOT / item["normalized_path"], logical_path=item["normalized_path"]).translations if key(item["normalized_path"], row) == key(item["normalized_path"], item))["target"] for item in workset}
assert current[workset[0]["entry_revision_identity"]].count("嘿，你，现为守卫，进入休眠仓，保持警戒。") == 4
assert "嘿，我，现为守卫，进入休眠仓，保持警戒。" not in current[workset[0]["entry_revision_identity"]]
for old, new in (("一小队骷髅冲了进来，接管城门", "一小队骷髅转而去夺取城门"), ("抵御入侵的不死部落", "抵御步步逼近的亡灵大军"), ("组成一条火线", "排成射击队列")):
    target = current["e2c9218ea95a18baa45059280337170935967edba71fca669c1529a01f214b26"]
    assert old not in target and target.count(new) == 1
for old, new in (("一旦他在这些方面都有了一些实战经验", "一旦他练到足以精通其中几项"), ("她终于见到了吸血鬼领主迎面而来。", "她终于与吸血鬼领主正面交锋。"), ("发表了一番关于不公平的费解的话", "含糊不清地咒骂了一通不公平")):
    target = current["cc6d1a5034ef0a29fd00222ed3d95df63125db3f7784febbe1270fe331b14359"]
    assert old not in target and target.count(new) == 1
print(json.dumps({"verified": True, "runtime": "manifest LuaJIT via LocaleLoader", "base_revision": BASE, "lua_loaded_files": list(FILES), "record_counts": record_counts, "translation_counts": translation_counts, "changed_target_count": len(changed), "changed": changed, "changed_set_exact": True, "all_other_records_unchanged": True, "non_target_fields_unchanged": True, "lf_tab_blank_terminal_invariants": True, "placeholder_markup_template_invariants": True, "claim_fragments_exact": True}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
'","workdir":"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation","yield_time_ms":30000,"max_output_tokens":20000});
